listings.name: Acropolis View Urban Suite by Zeus suites
listings.description:
This is an exceptional apartment located in the heart of Athens, directly across from Klafthmonos Square, offering immediate access to the city's core. The popular Ermou Street, the most well-known shopping street in Athens, is just a short walk away, while Syntagma Square is only 7 minutes away on foot. A key advantage is that the apartment shares the building with the Tourist Police, providing a sense of security.Additionally, you can enjoy a walk in the Plaka area and the Acropolis!

Our property stands out for its unique blend of elegance and warmth. With modern decor, thoughtful details, and all the amenities you need, we create a space that exudes comfort and style. Guests feel instantly welcome thanks to our friendly approach and attention to their needs, while our prime location places you right at the heart of the city's vibrant energy. We’re here to ensure your stay is enjoyable and filled with wonderful moments.

The accommodation is located in the high-end area of Athens, where all artistic events, gastronomy, and entertainment can be found in Agion Theodoron Square, just 100 meters away from our property, and in Agia Irini Square, which is 500 meters away on foot. We are just steps away from Syntagma Square, surrounded by vibrant nightlife, bustling shops, art galleries, restaurants, and close to timeless landmarks such as the Acropolis and the Ancient Agora. Additionally, we share the building with the Tourist Police. The nearest metro station, "Panepistimio," is 250 meters away. Nearby popular points of interest include Ermou Street, 800 meters away, Syntagma Metro Station, 700 meters away, and Syntagma Square, also 700 meters away on foot. The closest airport is Eleftherios Venizelos Airport, located 31 km from the property.

listings.name: Apollon Family Apartment by zeussuites
listings.description:
A charming stay with character in the heart of Patision.
This apartment is located in one of the most historic buildings in the area, known for its classic Athenian architecture. The building itself features an impressive marble entrance and timeless construction that speaks to the elegance of early 20th-century design. High ceilings, vintage elements, and authentic materials create a warm, nostalgic atmosphere — perfect for those who appreciate character and history in their stay.

The building holds historical significance, as it once served as the residence for ambassadors, making it a landmark of both diplomatic and architectural importance.

Situated on Patision Avenue, the apartment is just a 7-minute walk from the National Archaeological Museum of Athens, one of the most important museums in the world dedicated to ancient Greek art. The museum houses an extensive collection of artifacts from prehistoric times to late antiquity, offering a deep insight into Greece’s rich history and cultural legacy.

The location is also very convenient:

Just 5 minutes on foot from Victoria Station (Green Line)

And from this point on Patision, you can even catch a glimpse of the Acropolis in the distance — a perfect reminder of the city's ancient splendor (please note: this view is from the street, not from the apartment itself).

Whether you're visiting for leisure, history, or convenience, this stay offers a unique and memorable Athenian experience.

listings.name: Museum Family Apartment by Zeussuites
listings.description:
A charming stay with character in the heart of Patision.
This apartment is located in one of the most historic buildings in the area, known for its classic Athenian architecture. The building itself features an impressive marble entrance and timeless construction that speaks to the elegance of early 20th-century design. High ceilings, vintage elements, and authentic materials create a warm, nostalgic atmosphere — perfect for those who appreciate character and history in their stay.

The building holds historical significance, as it once served as the residence for ambassadors, making it a landmark of both diplomatic and architectural importance.

Situated on Patision Avenue, the apartment is just a 7-minute walk from the National Archaeological Museum of Athens, one of the most important museums in the world dedicated to ancient Greek art. The museum houses an extensive collection of artifacts from prehistoric times to late antiquity, offering a deep insight into Greece’s rich history and cultural legacy.

The location is also very convenient:

Just 5 minutes on foot from Victoria Station (Green Line)

And from this point on Patision, you can even catch a glimpse of the Acropolis in the distance — a perfect reminder of the city's ancient splendor (please note: this view is from the street, not from the apartment itself).

Whether you're visiting for leisure, history, or convenience, this stay offers a unique and memorable Athenian experience.
